review_notes: I read the whole file. I grepped Mathlib for comul_antipode, antipode_comul and comul_comp_antipode. The only match was the categorical CategoryTheory.HopfObj.antipode_comul in Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Monoidal/Hopf_.lean. That is a different representation (braided Hopf objects in a monoidal category), and the file's docstring says it is the concrete form of it. I found no concrete Hopf-algebra version in Mathlib, and no other Formal Frontier file defines one. The only new definitions are the private helpers antipodeContraction and antipodeOuterContraction. These are proof-local linear maps built from Mathlib's map, mul', assoc and tensorTensorTensorComm, so they are not competing versions of an existing concept. The antipode lemma for IsSkewPrimitiveElem extends the Mathlib predicate rather than replacing it. I found nothing that justifies a finding under this rubric.
